searchText: <@97774605351010304> what happened to the consensus explorer? https://goerli.beaconcha.in/block/3875413 it’s a merged explorer now /slots/{slot} or /block/{block} thanks! slots is what I was missing /address/{address} and transactions all the links are broken, if I click on "parent root" it goes to block, not slot can we go back to the previous version until we are merged? or this isn't deployed in mainnet yet? will be fixed tomorrow Doubt, this is the pre-stage before we deploy on mainnet in 2 days. thanks! please do not change mainnet until it's final at least? we do go to do quick checks in the explorer. Although I suppose there'll be other explorers around. I was analizing a reorg in Goerli, and it's easy to click there than searching for roots in a forkchoice dump What do you mean with final? We plan to deploy it pre-merge for better UX for average users pls let me know if you find further bugs. The one above should be an easy fix No please, this explorer is working fine, do not update it until at least we have finalized it after the merge. People still have other execution explorers and you're not likely to gain many new users by having this feature premerge
